heroHeadline: FDA Grants Accelerated Approval to Subcutaneous Amivantamab for Head and Neck Cancer — Days After Talazoparib-Enzalutamide Approval in HRR-Mutated Prostate Cancer
heroSubtitle: On November 5, 2026, the FDA granted accelerated approval to amivantamab and hyaluronidase-lpuj (Rybrevant Faspro) for recurrent or metastatic head and neck squamous cell carcinoma. On October 26, the agency approved talazoparib with enzalutamide for metastatic prostate cancer with HRR gene mutations.
footerNote: Data sourced from FDA Drug Approvals, NIH/NCI, peer-reviewed journals (NEJM, The Lancet, JCO, Nature, Nature Medicine), ASCO/ESMO/AACR conference data, and institutional analyses. All clinical data reflect published and presented trial results.
